title: review findings are written by a verb, every validator warning family carries a code the lint can see, and a fresh worktree's evidence is counted
desiredOutcome: A sign-off's findings and their resolutions are recorded through a verb under the lock with a journal row, and the outcome's tally is derived from them; the stable-code lint reaches every warning _check_phase_gate emits; check-example-ledgers judges pointers and ledgers over the same set, so a phase's second task gate in a fresh worktree is not red on the first gate's pointer.

tasks.title: a verb records a sign-off finding and its resolution, and the outcome's tally is derived from the findings
tasks.description: F516 (quality-gates-internal PLAN.md). Add a verb that appends a finding in the schema's shape (id, severity low|med|high, file, issue, resolution) under the index lock, revalidating or rolling back, with a review.finding journal row; a way to set a finding's resolution to its fix task and commit when the fix lands; and derive the severity tally in review.outcome from review.findings when the verb writes it, so no one types it. A text-only correction of review.outcome or summary goes through a verb with its own journal row and never re-decides the verdict. phase-signoff.md step 1 names the verb. Red-first: a malformed finding (missing severity, severity outside the vocabulary) is refused before any write; allow: a well-formed one is appended and journaled; a correction leaves the verdict and its row untouched.

add: plugins/audit/tests/test_audit_task.py: repro that FAILS on current code - a finding with a severity outside low|med|high can only be written by hand, and nothing refuses it

outcome.technical: finding, resolve-finding and correct verbs under the index lock with journal rows; outcome_with_tally on every review.outcome write.
outcome.descriptive: Sign-off findings and their fixes are recorded by a command instead of a hand edit, and the outcome's tally can no longer disagree with the list.

tasks.title: the stable-code lint reaches every warning the phase-gate checks emit
tasks.description: F517 (quality-gates-internal PLAN.md). _check_phase_gate mutates the validator's warnings parameter, a shape fc2's walk never follows, so the whole family can ship uncoded. Give _check_phase_gate (and its helpers) the return shape the walk already follows - it returns its findings and the caller extends - rather than adding a new seed rule. Red-first: strip the code from one _check_coupling warning and fc2 goes red; allow: every coded site stays green and the validator's output is byte-identical before and after.

add: plugins/audit/tests/test__output.py: repro that FAILS on current code - stripping the code from a _check_coupling warning leaves fc2 green

outcome.technical: _check_phase_gate returns its findings for the caller to extend; the walk reads a feeder's early literal return.
outcome.descriptive: Every warning the phase-gate checks emit now carries a stable code, and the lint would catch one that does not.

tasks.title: check-example-ledgers judges pointers and ledgers over the same set
tasks.description: F519 (quality-gates-internal PLAN.md). The tool reads pointers from the working-tree manifests but counts only git-tracked ledgers, so a phase's second task gate in a fresh worktree goes red on the first gate's pointer into the still-untracked evidence file. Judge both halves over the same set - read pointers from manifests at HEAD (the committed claim this tool exists to check). Red-first: a fixture repo whose tracked manifest at HEAD has no pointer to the untracked ledger while the working-tree manifest does passes; allow: a manifest at HEAD pointing at a run no ledger holds still fails.

add: tools/check-example-ledgers.py: repro that FAILS on current code - a manifest pointer into an untracked ledger file in a fresh worktree fails el2

outcome.technical: check-example-ledgers reads pointers and ledger rows at HEAD through one git cat-file batch.
outcome.descriptive: A task gate in a fresh worktree no longer fails because an earlier gate's evidence file is not committed yet.
